prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 1-1: page #F9FBFA, text #1F2D2A, accent #1D5986, secondary surface #EEE7EF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Roboto; condensed heading with regular interface text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 16px, heading 48px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
